text: Consensus offers an API to embed up-to-date peer-reviewed citations into custom workflows
quote: Connect the Consensus API within your project to seamlessly integrate up-to-date peer-reviewed citations into your own custom workflow.

text: Citation Graph maps a seed paper's prior work, later influence, and co-cited studies
quote: The Consensus Citation Graph turns a single seed paper into a complete map of the work that built it, the work it inspired, and the studies most often read alongside it.

text: Users can bulk-import thousands of papers into a personal library in one click
quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.

text: Full-text analysis extends to paywalled papers from major publishers
quote: Consensus analyzes the full text, including paywalled papers from major publishers, so you can find the most relevant papers.

text: Chained citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, and similar-paper discovery act like an autonomous research agent
quote: Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.

text: Supports search, screening, extraction, and synthesis of evidence for literature reviews
quote: Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.

text: Entire imported research library becomes a searchable, AI-powered workspace
quote: The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.

text: Searches over 200 million academic papers using language models to find and synthesize literature
quote: It searches over 200 million academic papers and uses language models to help you find, understand, and synthesize the literature faster.

text: Every AI-generated response includes citations tracing back to the original source
quote: Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.

text: Supports importing papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS files
quote: Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS

text: API can run automated discovery searches to find relevant research at scale
quote: Save your team hours of manual discovery research and run automated searches with our API to quickly and easily find the most relevant and reliable research.

text: A REST API and an MCP server both expose the same retrieval and synthesis functionality as the web app
quote: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app

text: Deep Search mode runs more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies
quote: Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)

text: Consensus Meter visually aggregates papers as supporting, refuting, or mixed for yes/no research questions
quote: The Consensus Meter is a visual aggregator that, for a yes/no/possibly question, classifies each relevant paper as supporting, refuting, or mixed/inconclusive

text: Filters let users narrow results by study type, year, journal, open-access status, and discipline
quote: Filters allow narrowing by study type (RCT, meta-analysis, systematic review, observational), publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline.

text: Automatically extracts PICO (population, intervention, comparator, outcome) elements from papers
quote: Extracted population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) where applicable
